risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and identifies material operating, credit, real estate, impairment, and covenant risks, but relies on management estimates and forward-looking qualifications in several areas. Results show recurring net losses, declining revenues, significant impairment charges, a large doubtful-accounts reserve, weak real estate demand, and customer concentration/competitive pressure.
